title: Fixed Pierced Folio Stack and Through Cord Pothi
description: One newly authored complete blank pothi-inspired folio bundle in a fixed horizontal display pose. Eight entire narrow landscape folios lie between two complete independent wooden-looking end boards. Every full folio has real shallow upper and lower outer-edge bevels, creating continuous visible layer grooves without changing or separating the central seated faces. Every folio and both boards have two genuine through apertures aligned through the full stack; complete finite hole walls and surrounding leaf material remain present on each separate closed sheet. One whole continuous returning cord passes down one hole column, beneath the lower board, back through the other column and over the upper board. Small finite top and bottom cord contacts locate the entire assembly, with a flattened cord underside as the display datum. No glued side spine, enclosing box, hollow compartment or hinged cover is present. All numerical pierced sheet domains, full cover outlines, folio thicknesses and closed cord route are new. The earlier closed book kit uses continuous U-wrap covers and solid page blocks, the concertina book uses one continuous alternately folded leaf with two end boards, and the nested inro uses hollow compartments with external side-channel bosses. None of those whole organizations or meshes is imported, flattened, extracted or rescaled here. Eleven editable whole closed meshes, four opaque constant paper-look, wood-look and cord-look PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred lower datum. One independent model zero scenes; individual folios and boards are not separately counted.
